title: Select and implement Visionary-Tiny-D1 trainable architecture and output heads
whatBuilt: FROZEN ARCHITECTURE: input(VMM-06 dim 7) -> dense(8, tanh) -> dense(action logits) -> masked softmax over the VATS ACT strategy set; 109 parameters matching the documented candidate-size comparison (heuristic teacher 0, BKT 4, NB O(vocab), Tiny-D1 109)
MASKED OUTPUTS: only the caller's ALLOWED actions compete; masked logits are -inf so masked probabilities are exactly 0 and a masked action is never ranked; unknown/invalid allowed sets refused
ALL-ACTIONS-FORBIDDEN as a defined output ({abstained, reason: all_actions_forbidden}) — never a crash, never a forced pick
LOSS: masked cross-entropy + L2; deterministic SGD under the seed (identical seeds -> identical trajectories and predictions, proven); training reduces loss on synthetic policy-imitation data

CALIBRATION + ABSTENTION: softmax probabilities with a confidence floor (below-floor abstains); OOD gates — missingness above the training bound and features outside the observed range abstain with explicit reasons

CONDITIONAL HEADS: a misconception head is enabled ONLY with sufficient labels per class (minPerClass); enabling without enough labels is refused, never silently degraded; head parameter cost documented

POLICY-IMITATION SANITY: labels from the VMM-05 reproduction of the reference VATS pedagogy on synthetic evidence snapshots (features via VMM-06 extractor); held-out teacher agreement >= 0.7 validates the training loop, not educational quality
VMM-04 INTEGRATION: Tiny-D1 evaluated through the benchmark registry (runner records, custodian grades); educationalGainsEstablished stays False

verification.vmmTests: npm run ml:vmm:test -> 65/65 pass (12 supplychain/exposure + 10 seeddata + 10 benchmarks + 9 baselines + 11 features + 13 tinyd1)

status: Testing (submit candidate; D-095 separate reviewer + exact reviewed SHA required before Done)
gatesNotClosed: No real learner data, no cloud training, no deployment; policy-imitation agreement validates the training loop only. Testing status is not acceptance; the R0 research-gate prerequisite keeps its own signoff flow.
